name: dfir-iris/iris-web
description: A web-based collaborative incident response platform enabling security teams to share technical information, coordinate investigations, and maintain structured case notes during security incidents. Extensible via modules for data enrichment and SIEM/SOAR integration.
score_rationale: Well-maintained collaborative IR platform with 1.4k stars and a January 2026 release, providing structured case management for DFIR team coordination.
